description: For teams building AI who need expert human data: AITraining.jobs runs expert evaluation, rubrics, preference (RLHF) data, fine-tuning data, RL environments, red-teaming and benchmarks with US professionals from its own network (physicians, nurses, attorneys, accountants, engineers, scientists, translators). Returns what it delivers, the network's live counts by field, what each kind of expert is paid for AI work today, how projects are priced and run, and the page to brief it. Optionally one field.

field.description: One field, e.g. 'medical', 'legal', 'finance', 'coding', 'red-teaming'. Omit for every field.
